deviations.text: The retained source snapshots live in the session scratch of the D109 run, not in the repository; each of the 17 files was re-hashed and equals the sha256 recorded in the tracked D109 ledger, which is the only basis for treating them as retained and hash-bound.

Startup read-ahead reused the relay, funnel, guard-orientation and gotchas reads already made earlier in this session; this run added the work order, receipt, the three proposal inputs, checker constants for probe admission and SCEC, and a scoped control lookup. Not every startup document was re-read in full.
The harness-reported platform string (Windows 11 Home Single Language) is used only as a feasibility caveat for virtual-disk tooling; it is not a governed host-read and nothing was inventoried.

Platform semantics of job objects, quotas, firewall scope and resolver traffic are general platform knowledge, not retained evidence; every such statement is labelled an unverified claim to be tested by a fixture.
The preset entry hash and file hash are taken from the manifest and review as retained claims; the voices file was not re-read because no direct mirror read is admitted here.
Console printing of the draft failed once on a code-page encoding error before the file was read through the file reader; no content was lost or written.
